ev.q: Rates of rebound of SARS-CoV-2 RNA shedding, identified based on an increase in nasopharyngeal viral RNA levels
Among subjects with a virologic response through day 5, viral RNA rebound occurred in 6.4%–8.4%
were similar between nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and placebo recipients
Evaluation of SARS-CoV-2 RNA Rebound After Nirmatrelvir/Ritonavir Treatment in Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trials
The authors conducted retrospective analyses of viral RNA shedding levels in nasopharyngeal samples

methods_quotes.q: Exploratory statistical analyses were conducted using two-sided Fisher’s exact tests to provide nominal p-values, without multiplicity adjustments
rebound rates were compared between nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and placebo recipients who had a virologic response on day 5
